description: This PHP source file defines the BulkLeaveAPI class, which provides an API endpoint for performing bulk operations (approve, cancel, reject) on leave requests within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for updating leave statuses, handling request parameters, and managing transactions.
